title: The Effect of an AI-Based, Autonomous, Digital Health Intervention Using Precise Lifestyle Guidance on Blood Pressure in Adults With Hypertension: Single-Arm Nonrandomized Trial.
summary: A single-arm trial tested an AI-based autonomous digital intervention with personalized lifestyle guidance and measured blood-pressure changes in adults with hypertension; the uncontrolled design limits causal inference.
